description: Ask whether a phone number, domain, email, or app is a channel an organization publishes on its own site. Hunch answers only from a public-source list (facts taken from each organization's own pages, with a source link and date, not confirmed to Hunch): anything not on it is reported as 'not listed', never as 'unofficial'. Absence is never evidence against a channel.

channel.description: Optional: the specific channel to check (a domain, email, phone, or app). Omit to list the confirmed channels.

org.description: The organization name to look up (required), e.g. a bank or a company.

name: check_official_channel
title: Check an official channel
